user.title: Connect your ANWB Laadpas
user.description: Choose how you want to sign in.

login.title: Log in via the browser
login.description:
1. Open [this login page]({authorize_url}) and log in with your ANWB Laadpas account, including the verification code.
2. You end up on a laadpas.anwb.nl page. Copy the full address from the address bar right away; it contains `?code=...` and is only valid for a few minutes.
3. Paste it below.

If the page moves on before you can copy the address: open the developer tools (F12), Network tab, enable 'Preserve log', log in again and copy the URL of the request to `/account/login?code=...`.

data_description.redirect_url: The full address, starting with laadpas.anwb.nl/account/login?code=

token.title: Paste a refresh token
token.description:
Log in on laadpas.anwb.nl with the developer tools (F12) open. In the Network tab, find the request to `connect/token` and copy `refresh_token` from its response.

Note: refresh tokens are single use. After Home Assistant uses it, your browser session may ask you to log in again.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The ANWB Laadpas login has expired or was revoked. Log in again to continue receiving charging sessions.

error.invalid_redirect_url: This address does not contain a valid login code for this attempt. Copy the full address after logging in with the link shown here.
error.invalid_code: The login code was already used or has expired. Open the new login link and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The token was not accepted. Copy a fresh one and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the ANWB Laadpas service.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the ANWB Laadpas service.
abort.invalid_auth: Login succeeded, but the charging sessions could not be read.
abort.no_refresh_token: The login did not return a refresh token.
abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different account than the one configured.

init.title: ANWB Laadpas options
init.description: Set how often to check for new sessions. You can also give each of your {card_count} charging cards a name; the fields are labelled with the card number. Leave a field empty to use the card number.
